overview_description.description: VoiceOps provides a conversation intelligence platform that focuses on coaching and training for sales teams. The platform captures and analyzes call data, offering insights into how sales representatives communicate with prospects and customers. It is designed to identify behaviors, measure adherence to sales processes, and highlight areas for improvement. VoiceOps enables managers to track coaching effectiveness and ensure that strategies are consistently applied across teams.

about_short_description.short_description: VoiceOps provides a conversation intelligence platform that focuses on coaching and training for sales teams.

product.name: Automated QA & Coaching
product.description: An AI-driven system that auto-grades call scorecards, supports self-learning from QA teams, issues compliance alerts, and generates coaching documents to manage quality assurance and coaching processes.

product.name: Voice of the Customer
product.description: An AI platform that extracts customer insights from calls, including objections, motivations, churn risks, and competitive comparisons to inform marketing, product, and strategy teams.

product.name: Complete Customer Interaction Suite
product.description: A comprehensive AI platform combining automated QA, coaching, and customer insight features with unlimited models and priority access to new AI capabilities.
